sources.name: GitHub issues of gpbl/react-day-picker
sources.version: GitHub REST API 2022-11-28, state as of 2026-11-11
sources.license: GitHub Terms of Service (user content; only facts and our own summaries are kept)

provenance.notes: URL, number, title, state, dates, counts and labels are copied from the API response of each issue. Category, components, summary, resolution and lesson are written by the researcher (tools/extract/field-reports/curation) after reading the issue body returned by the search API and, for the issues listed in docs/research/field-reports.md, the full thread. daysOpen of an open issue is measured to the retrieval date. fixedBy is filled mechanically from merged pull requests that name the issue after a closing keyword. Reports marked needs-review state a cause that the researcher inferred from the symptom without a confirming statement in the issue.

reports.title: Support locales like Arabic with different representation of numerals
reports.summary: The picker could not render day numbers in the digits of locales such as Arabic.
reports.lesson: Day, week and year numbers are formatted with the locale's numbering system by default.

reports.title: RTL keyboard handling issues
reports.summary: In RTL the arrow keys moved the focused day in the direction opposite to the key.
reports.lesson: Calendar-grid navigation maps arrows to visual neighbours in both directions.

reports.title: Default stylesheet doesn't handle ranges for dir="rtl"
reports.summary: The default stylesheet's range styling — rounded ends for the first and last day — was wrong under dir="rtl", and the maintainer noted that most custom stylesheets would have the same problem.
reports.lesson: Range start/end styling uses logical radii so that any custom theme inherits correct RTL behaviour.

reports.title: Navigation buttons with wrong aria labels on rtl direction
reports.summary: With dir="rtl" the next and previous buttons were only partially swapped: behaviour changed sides but the accessible labels did not, so the button announced as "next" went to the previous month.
reports.lesson: A navigation button's label, icon and action are one unit that is positioned by logical order; they are never swapped independently.

reports.title: Arrows not moving in the right direction?
reports.summary: With dir="rtl" the left and right arrow keys moved focus opposite to their direction in the day grid — three years after the same defect was first fixed.
reports.lesson: The RTL keyboard tests are generated from the pattern definition and cannot be dropped in a rewrite.

reports.title: v7: Direction of arabic days is wrong
reports.summary: With the Arabic locale the weekday header was wrong: the reporter expected the week to read from Saturday on the right, and the header order did not match the day columns.
reports.lesson: Weekday header and day cells are produced by the same column order (first day of week from region data); fixture: Arabic (Saudi Arabia, Egypt) header order equals cell weekday order.

reports.title: Caption buttons are inverted when using dir="rtl"
reports.summary: With several months displayed and dir="rtl", the caption's navigation buttons changed their icons but not their positions.

fixedBy.title: fix: caption buttons inverted when using RTL and multiple months

reports.lesson: With multiple months, previous sits on the inline-start month and next on the inline-end month.

reports.title: Incorrect Jalali Month Names in react-day-picker
reports.summary: The Jalali build with the Persian locale showed Gregorian month names transliterated into Persian (April, May …) instead of Persian calendar month names.

fixedBy.title: fix(jalali): defaults calendar to `faIR` locale and RTL direction

reports.lesson: Month names are looked up by (calendar, locale); a locale's Gregorian names are never reused for another calendar.

reports.title: The icon's left and right directions are reversed in RTL (right-to-left) mode
reports.summary: In RTL the chevron icons point the wrong way relative to their action, and the user could not find how to customise them per direction.
reports.lesson: Icon slots receive the resolved direction, and defaults are mirrored.

reports.title: `timeZone` prop breaks Persian calendar rendering for old years (e.g. 1313) in `Asia/Tehran`
reports.summary: With a time zone set, the Persian calendar failed to render old years (1313 in Asia/Tehran), where historical UTC offsets are not whole hours or minutes.

fixedBy.title: feat: add experimental `noonSafe` prop for timezone offsets

reports.lesson: Calendar conversion operates on civil dates (year, month, day) without passing through time-zone-dependent timestamps.

reports.title: @daypicker/hijri: Umm al-Qura dates disagree with ICU's islamic-umalqura from 2029-08-11
reports.summary: The Hijri add-on's Umm al-Qura conversion agrees with the browser's Intl implementation for every day from 2024 until 10 August 2029 and disagrees from 11 August 2029 onward.
reports.lesson: Hijri conversion is cross-checked against ICU for the full supported range in CI, and the range for which official data exists is documented, with behaviour beyond it defined.
